summary.text: Anthony Thompson, also known as Tony, is the Democratic candidate for Iowa State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Wes Enos.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a fourth-generation Iowa farmer, small business owner and former data scientist.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Thompson was born in Des Moines, graduated from North Polk High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Cornell College in 2000 and a Ph.D. from the Blekinge Institute of Technology in 2012, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2024 survey he said he was raised on the family's century farm near Elkhart.
In the 2026 survey, Thompson said he previously worked in agricultural finance and data science and earlier managed the Habitat for Humanity ReStore in Des Moines.
He said his family operates Prudent Produce, a local food hub that connects Iowa families with local farmers.
Thompson was the Democratic nominee for Iowa House District 45 in 2024, when incumbent Brian Lohse defeated him, according to Ballotpedia.
In 2026 he advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary.
He named agriculture and conservation, public education, and business and the economy as policy areas he is passionate about, and said communities should have local control where possible.
